item.tib: srid rgyal dbal mo'i zlog gzhung gi rtsang rabs zlog pa
item.coloph: de ltar mkha' 'gro'i lung bzhin du/ nges med rnal 'byor tshul 'dzin pos/ yi ge ris su bkod pa dge skal ldan yongs la phan par shog dam med rnams la gsang rgya tham/ sa ma ya/ rgya rgya rgya//

item.tib: srid rgyal dbal mo'i zlog gzhung gi rtsang rabs zlog pa
item.coloph: de ltar rtsang rabs zlog pa 'dis/ 'gal rkyen bar chod thams cad bzlog sdang dgra gnod bgegs 'jom par 'gyur/ ye shes mkha' 'gro'i lung bzhin du/ nges med rnal 'byor tshul 'dzin pos/ yi ge ris su bkod pa dge skal ldan yongs la phan par shog dam med rnams la u ya smrar// sa ma ya/ rgya rgya rgya//
